ai.label: An AI provider

whatYouGet.0: The agent can write replacement titles and meta descriptions, not just tell you they're wrong
whatYouGet.2: The SEO chat and 'ask the tool' assistant
whatYouGet.3: Content briefs, blog drafts, and the AI audit

ai.withoutIt: Everything that finds problems still works. Anything that writes new wording is unavailable — the agent will flag a 102-character title but can't propose a shorter one.

steps.0: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with any Google account.
steps.1: Click 'Create API key', then 'Create API key in new project' if it asks.
steps.2: Copy the key — it starts with AIza.
steps.3: Paste it on the AI settings page and save.
steps.4: Groq is an equally good free alternative if you'd rather not use Google.

google.label: Google Search Console + Analytics

whatYouGet.0: Rankings come from Google's own data instead of being scraped — more accurate, and it can't be rate-limited
whatYouGet.1: Real clicks, impressions and CTR per query
whatYouGet.2: Quick wins: the keywords you rank 4th-15th for, where one push reaches page one
whatYouGet.3: Content decay detection — pages quietly losing traffic

google.withoutIt: Rank tracking falls back to loading search results in a headless browser. It works, it's free, and it's slower and noisier than Google telling you directly.

steps.0: Make sure the site is verified in Search Console — if you can see its data there, you're set.
steps.1: Open the Google page below and click Connect.
steps.2: Sign in and approve read-only access.
steps.3: Pick which Search Console property belongs to which client.

bing.label: Bing Webmaster Tools

whatYouGet.0: Backlinks — Microsoft shares their own link graph for sites you've verified, which is the best free backlink data available
whatYouGet.1: Real search volume on keyword research, measured rather than estimated
whatYouGet.2: Submit URLs to Bing for indexing

bing.withoutIt: Backlinks are limited to what you log by hand or import from a CSV, and keyword research has no volume figures to sort by.

steps.0: Open Bing Webmaster Tools and sign in. You can import your sites straight from Search Console.
steps.1: Verify the site if it isn't already — Bing only shares link data for verified sites.
steps.2: Click the gear icon → Settings → API access → API key.
steps.3: Copy the key and paste it on the Bing page below.

pagespeed.label: PageSpeed Insights

whatYouGet.0: Higher rate limits on speed and Core Web Vitals checks
whatYouGet.1: Fewer 'try again later' errors when auditing several pages at once

pagespeed.withoutIt: Speed checks still run — Google allows a small number of anonymous requests. You'll hit the limit if you audit a lot of pages in one go.

steps.0: Open the link below and click 'Get a Key'.
steps.1: Pick or create a Google Cloud project — the free quota is 25,000 requests a day.
steps.2: Copy the key and paste it on the AI settings page, under PageSpeed.

wordpress.label: WordPress

whatYouGet.0: The agent can apply fixes directly — titles, meta descriptions, alt text, schema
whatYouGet.1: Every change is logged with its previous value and undoable in one click
whatYouGet.2: Stop copying suggestions into WordPress by hand

wordpress.withoutIt: The agent still finds problems and turns them into tasks. It just can't act on them — you apply the fixes yourself.

steps.0: Install the companion plugin on the client's WordPress site.
steps.1: In the plugin settings, copy the generated key.
steps.2: Open the client's page in this app, then Edit, and paste it under WordPress.
steps.3: Use 'Test connection' to confirm before turning the agent up.

smtp.label: Email delivery

whatYouGet.0: Send reports to clients from this app
whatYouGet.1: Scheduled monthly reports that go out on their own

smtp.withoutIt: Reports still generate and download as PDFs — you send them however you already do.

steps.0: Get SMTP details from your email provider (Gmail, Fastmail, your host, or a service like Resend).
steps.1: For Gmail you'll need an App Password, not your normal password.
steps.2: Enter the host, port, username and password on the email settings page.
steps.3: Send a test to yourself before relying on it.
